UNH's September 'other' was under 1%, recorded as 0.5. The June UNH poll was before the primary but already tested Gray against Rodgers.

Twenty states elect a lieutenant governor in 2026 on a joint ticket with the governor, so those races are not listed separately: AK, CO, CT, FL, HI, IL, IA, KS, MD, MA, MI, MN, NE, NM, NY, OH, PA, SC, SD, WI. In HI, NM, PA and WI, plus some others, the lieutenant governor is nominated in a separate primary, but the two run as one ticket in November. The uploaded LG primary files for those states are listed here. Ten states elect a lieutenant governor in a separate November 3, 2026 race, and each has its own object: AL, AR, CA, GA, ID, NV, OK, RI, TX, VT. AZ, ME, NH, OR, WY and TN have no lieutenant governor or give the title to the senate president. Other separately elected lieutenant governors, such as DE, LA, MS, MO, NC, VA and WA, are not up in 2026.
